sloka: न अराजके जनपदे चन्दनागुरुरूषिताः ।राजपुत्रा विराजन्ते वसन्त इव शाखिनः ॥२-६७-२८॥
transliteration: na arājake janapade candanāgururūṣitāḥ ।rājaputrā virājante vasanta iva śākhinaḥ ॥2-67-28॥

translations.english: In a country where there is no king, the princes, anointed with sandal paste and agaru, no longer look graceful like blosoming trees in spring time.
